rootCause.fact: AgentTurnCapabilities.conclusion is a Harness invariant and DeepSeekTurnAdapter requires submit_run_conclusion (or another admitted Harness/Runtime action). A valid Provider conclusion is returned in AgentTurnResult.conclusion; AgentTurnResult.content may legitimately be empty.
rootCause.consumerDefect: The R1 experiment runner evaluated only AgentTurnResult.content with a bespoke JSON parser and did not retain AgentTurnResult.conclusion/structured_result. Therefore the preregistered evaluator was attached to the wrong carrier.
rootCause.attribution: experiment-consumer apparatus, not Recursive LEGO R2.1 semantics and not DeepSeek effective-model identity

evidenceBoundary.calibrationReuse: R1 calibration task instances were exposed to the Provider and must not be reused as R2 calibration/inferential units

repair.mechanism: Use Harness structured-result-v1 completion contract with caller-owned resultSchema {choice: enum(option ids)} and evaluate AgentRunConclusion.structured_result instead of free-text content.
repair.taskPolicy: Generate a new disjoint R2 calibration bank; do not modify R1 trial records or gate thresholds.
repair.ownerPolicy: Reuse Harness structured completion; do not change DeepSeek adapter or create a parallel result protocol.

nonClaims: R1 does not show that Recursive LEGO R2.1 is ineffective.
R1 does not show that Recursive LEGO R2.1 is effective.
The observed token difference between arms is descriptive apparatus cost only and is not an efficacy estimate.
